repeat audit (`console-we1`).

`employment_status='ACTIVE'` (EXITED peers do not inflate).

## Test plan
- [x] leave-domain 31/31; leave-rest lib 10/10; leave-rls PG pin EXITED
headcount 15/15
- [ ] CI Required green

ci: docs-only path-class step gates (console-7rc)

Replace the blocked job-level docs_only if: design with mechanism B:
preflight classifies changed paths, emits path_class/docs_only/run_heavy,
and expensive leaves keep success via path-class skip proofs plus
run_heavy-gated steps. Required/CI stays success-only; foundation-gates
paths ban untouched.

fix(ci): include deletions in path-class inventory (console-7rc)

ACMR dropped deleted product paths, so docs edit + backend delete
classified as docs-only and skipped heavy proofs. List the full
name-only diff and pin the hostile mixed case.

commit.message:
fix(ci): total path-class inventory across renames (console-q58y)

git diff --name-only without --no-renames drops rename sources, so a
product→docs rename could classify as docs-only and skip heavy CI.
Pass --no-renames, pin the hostile rename case, and bump PATH_CLASS_RULES_VERSION to 3.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commit.message:
fix(ci): classify path-class steps in local verify PLAN (console-q58y)

assertPlanCoversCi failed closed on Classify path class and Path-class skip
proof after the path-class inventory landed. Mark both ci-only: emit needs
Actions PATH_CLASS_* SHAs (covered by CI preflight contract), and skip proofs
only run when run_heavy!=true while local verify always takes the heavy path.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
